::: notes
If you have finished the first reproduction, take a second, and choose it so that the two analyses differ in a single decision. 8PTRZ and UYV3F differ in the comparison: all other names against white names only. UYV3F and 25N5D differ in the emails counted: the replies against every delivered email. UYV3F and P9W8Y differ in the test: one coefficient against the three groups at once. Reproduce the second one in the same way. [advance] Then put the two on one scale. The statistics that Multi100 recorded cannot be compared directly, a chi-square here and a z there, so the table gives each analysis as a gap in percentage points, from the refit of the course. [advance] And write one sentence for your notes: which of your two answers the claim as it was selected, Hispanic against white names, and what question the other one answers instead.
:::
